headline: Panel class dependencies and implications
what_breaks: rich/align.py — relies on AlignMethod for title alignment
rich/box.py — uses Box and ROUNDED for border design
rich/text.py — depends on Text and TextType for titles and subtitles
rich/padding.py — utilizes Padding and PaddingDimensions for layout
why: The Panel class is a core component that manages the rendering of console panels, directly impacting how content is displayed. Changes to its dependencies could alter the visual output and functionality of multiple dependent files.
checklist: Review changes to AlignMethod in rich/align.py
Check updates to Box and ROUNDED in rich/box.py
Ensure compatibility with Text and TextType in rich/text.py
Validate any modifications to Padding and PaddingDimensions in rich/padding.py
